name: Swipeflog
description: Slash upward from low guard and let the blade rise on into a high guard in one motion.

name: Basketbarrier
description: Check an incoming cut with the spine and step back so the blow spends itself on air.

name: Flourish Scorer
description: Turn the blade over mid cut so the curved belly drags across the target for a longer slice.

name: Rugged Belly
description: Flick the point out at the opponent's wrist and pull it back to guard before a counter lands.

name: Dire Knucklebow
description: Cut with an edge sharpened by qi so the wound stings and slows the opponent's next swing.

name: Rooted Backedge
description: Wedge the spine under the opponent's blade and turn it aside so the guard opens for a follow cut.

name: Brutal Pipeback
description: Cut across the target and pass to the left so the body clears the line of the reply.

name: Yelmanflog
description: Cut across the target and pass to the right with the rear foot following close.

name: Vicious Basket
description: Step low and close under the opponent's eye line and lunge with the point at the ribs.

name: Stalwart Spinecurve
description: Cross the blade low in front of the shins to catch a cut at the legs.

name: Springing Gallop
description: Hop back out of reach and settle into guard with the point aimed at the opponent's face.

name: Rushing Yelman
description: Cut and step through the opponent's side in one motion so the body ends behind the guard arm.

name: Hungry Slantcut
description: Shift off the line on a light qi step and thrust along the new angle before the opponent can turn.

name: Armored Swell
description: Catch a heavy cut on the forte near the guard where the blade is strongest.

name: Cruel Whirl
description: Answer a parried blow with a short cut to the forearm before the opponent can recover.

name: Swellbarrier
description: Turn a cut aside on the inside of the blade with the point angled to the opponent's face.

name: Yelmanscreen
description: Ring the edge against the incoming blade so the shock runs up the opponent's arm and slows the reply.

name: Brawn Swipe
description: Swing a wide slash with room on both sides and the whole body behind the cut.

name: Brass Spinecurve
description: Advance at a steady march with the blade slanted across the front to turn any blow.

name: Fleet Flourish
description: Hop over a low obstacle and land in guard without letting the blade drop.

name: Knucklebow Swat
description: Extend the arm and lean from the hips so the point reaches past the opponent's guard.

name: Harsh Counterguard
description: Cut short from the elbow when comrades or foes stand close on either side.

name: Lunarbelly
description: Test the ground with the lead foot before committing weight so cuts stay balanced on broken footing.

name: Crimson Skimmer
description: Rake the edge down the opponent's blade and arm to drag the guard out of line before cutting.

name: Emberswipe
description: Rush through a gap in the opposing line with the blade swinging wide to clear room on both sides.

name: Gallopflog
description: Draw the blade out with the edge rotating into line just as the cut begins.

name: Swellhasp
description: Turn the wrist to present the flat of the blade and let a cut skid across it.

name: Swellswat
description: Hold the flat toward the opponent as a screen then roll the wrist so the edge lands.

name: Fleet Slantcut
description: Roll the edge across a pursuer's reach while stepping back to keep the distance.

name: Stern Swipe
description: Snap the edge round into the opponent's wrist with qi so the grip loosens and the blade drops.

name: Sturdy Pipeback
description: Roll the blade along an incoming edge and step off the line so the cut passes harmlessly.

name: Tethering Swell
description: Flick the point at the opponent's eyes to draw the guard up before the real cut.

name: Ruthless Skimmer
description: Cut high to pull the guard up and drop the blade at once to cut the legs.

name: Vicious Belly
description: Flick the point forward from a ready guard to test the opponent's reaction.

name: Levering Backedge
description: Drop the shoulder as if to cut low and draw the opponent's blade down before rising.

name: Counterguard Hasp
description: Pull the blade back fast from a feint to parry the counter that follows it.

name: Cramping Whirl
description: Show one cut then land a second from a different line so the opponent guards the wrong side.

name: Gallop Thwack
description: Pause in the middle of a cut then stab quickly while the opponent's guard is still timing the swing.

name: Whirlflog
description: Wheel the blade over the head in a full circle and bring it down on the target.

name: Bellybuckle

description: Open a bout with a plain diagonal cut that tests the opponent's guard and distance.

name: Counterguard Buckle
description: Slide the blade along the opponent's edge to turn it away and keep the point on line.

name: Gallopslap
description: Lock the arm straight and drive the point at the chest from a lunging step.

name: Bellyswat
description: Rake the edge forward across the opponent's guard hand as the body steps in.

name: Sturdy Yelman
description: Move from one guard to another without stopping so no line stays open for long.

name: Clay Falsedge
description: Drive the hilt into the opponent's face or chest when the bodies are too close for a cut.

name: Skimmer Hammerfall
description: Cut upward to lift the guard then turn the blade over and thrust into the opening beneath.

name: Humswell
description: Chain parries through high then middle then low lines with qi in the wrist to keep each one tight.

name: Draught Pipeback
description: End a bout with a flourish cut that bites the sword hand and sends a ringing shock up the arm.

name: Acrid Swell
description: Cut with the elbow held close to the ribs for a short fast stroke in cramped space.

name: Stubborn Falsedge
description: Check the opponent's weapon arm with the shoulder while the blade covers the body.

name: Rude Spinecurve
description: Strike the pommel up under the opponent's chin or down onto the knuckles.

name: Veering Belly
description: Step into the tight space beside the opponent's weapon arm where a long blade cannot reach.

name: Bellyflog
description: Hook the curved blade behind the opponent's arm and pull to bind the limb as the cut lands.

name: Backedge Prop
description: Parry with the forte and slip along a wall or corner to leave a tight spot unhurt.

name: Stalwart Knucklebow
description: Walk a patrol with the blade carried loose yet angled to cover the body against a sudden blow.

name: Rough Whirl
description: Cut across an oncoming person's path to halt them at the edge of reach.

name: Baskethasp
description: Parry at a street corner by turning the blade flat to the opening so a surprise cut slides off.

name: Swellflog
description: Draw and slash in one beat when a hand moves toward a weapon.

name: Prowling Flourish
description: Run in long even strides with the blade held back so a fleeing person can be caught.

name: Cruel Slantcut
description: Cut the sleeve or belt with the point and pin the cloth to a post or door.

name: Swell Hurdle
description: Step in fast on a pulse of qi and slash the moment a hidden foe moves.
